source_name: ČNB – Právní předpisy a metodické materiály v oblasti finančního trhu (legislativní základna)
why_relevant: Master hub of the entire ČNB regulatory corpus, split into ~22 sectoral sub-bases (banks and credit unions, payment and e-money institutions, AML, DORA, crypto-assets, consumer credit, recovery and resolution, sustainable finance). Every binding vyhláška, opatření and methodological material for a CZ bank or PSP is reachable from here, so it is the single highest-value crawl root for the whole A3 workstream.

source_name: ČNB – Právní předpisy: banky a družstevní záložny
why_relevant: Sector-specific consolidated list of the acts, ČNB vyhlášky and opatření that bind banks and credit unions (e.g. vyhláška 355/2020 Sb. on applications and information under the Banking Act, reporting vyhlášky). This is the canonical list a compliance-driven vendor must track for CZ banks.

source_name: ČNB – Legislativní základna: platební instituce a instituce elektronických peněz
why_relevant: The payments-sector rule base: zákon č. 370/2017 Sb. o platebním styku and the ČNB vyhlášky/opatření issued under it covering market entry, prudential rules, and information duties for PI/EMI/PSPMR/VEPMR. Directly scopes what a payments vendor's clients must comply with.

source_name: Věstník ČNB (Official Journal of the Czech National Bank) – ročníky/částky
why_relevant: Legally authentic publication channel for ČNB úřední sdělení and opatření — ČNB itself states that only the wording in the Sbírka zákonů or Věstník ČNB is authentic. Issued as numbered částky per ročník with third-party-citable 'třídicí znak' identifiers, giving a stable, dated, machine-trackable spine of every supervisory communication back to the 1990s.

source_name: ČNB – Dohledová úřední sdělení a benchmarky
why_relevant: The purest expression of CZ supervisory expectations: dohledové benchmarky generalise repeated supervisory findings into stated expectations (AML transaction monitoring, management and control system reviews, adverse-media/AML risk). These are exactly the soft-law documents that drive bank procurement of compliance and monitoring capability, and they exist nowhere else.

source_name: ČNB – Stanoviska k regulaci finančního trhu (RS opinions)
why_relevant: ČNB's interpretative opinions answering unclear points of financial-market law — the de-facto authority on how a rule will actually be applied to a bank or PSP. Numbered RS-series (e.g. RS2023-02 on access to payment accounts for payment-service provision), and a subset is mirrored in English.

source_name: ČNB – Konzultační materiály a návrhy (consultations and draft regulations)
why_relevant: The single best forward-looking source in the cell: chronological list of ČNB draft vyhlášky with odůvodnění (explanatory memoranda) and the state of the meziresortní připomínkové řízení, typically 2-3 weeks. Confirmed to carry payments-relevant drafts (PSP obligations on incident and fraud reporting) and banking supervision amendments tied to statutory changes effective January 2026. Gives 3-12 months' lead time on binding rules — exactly the A3 deadline signal.

source_name: ČNB – Sdělení ČNB o obecných pokynech evropských orgánů dohledu (ESA guidelines comply-or-explain)
why_relevant: Records which EBA/ESMA/EIOPA guidelines ČNB declares it will comply with, and from when — the transmission belt turning EU soft law into CZ supervisory expectation. Confirmed coverage includes DORA Art. 32(7) cooperation guidelines, AML Art.17/18(4) guidelines, ICT and security risk management, remuneration, and fit-and-proper. Essential for anticipating which EU requirements actually bite on CZ institutions.

source_name: ČNB – Stanoviska ČNB ke konzultačním materiálům EU a jiných mezinárodních institucí
why_relevant: ČNB's own submitted positions into EU/international consultations. Reveals the regulator's policy preferences before they harden into CZ practice — an early directional read that no downstream document provides.

source_name: ČNB – Regulace a dohled nad platebními institucemi a institucemi elektronických peněz
why_relevant: States how ČNB actually supervises payments firms — follow-up inspections on compliance, intervention toolkit up to withdrawal of authorisation. Frames the supervisory pressure that creates demand for compliance-side products in the CZ payments sector. EN mirror exists.

source_name: ČNB – Dohled nad úvěrovými institucemi
why_relevant: Banking-side counterpart describing ČNB's supervisory approach to credit institutions (banks, foreign branches, credit unions) — the mandate, tools and prudential focus that shape supervisory expectations on CZ banks.

source_name: ČNB – Co nového v dohledu (supervision news feed)
why_relevant: Running change log of the whole supervision chapter of cnb.cz — the cheapest single watchpoint that surfaces new úřední sdělení, benchmarks, methodologies and deadlines as they appear, and points at the underlying documents.

source_name: ČNB – RSS feeds
why_relevant: Machine-readable subscription layer for ČNB updates including the financial-market supervision chapter. Lowest-cost, lowest-fragility ingestion path for the entire cell. Note the documented exclusion: items served by special applications (Seznamy a evidence, Pravomocná rozhodnutí, Informace zveřejňované emitenty) are NOT in the feed and need separate scrapers.

source_name: ČNB – Pravomocná rozhodnutí České národní banky (final enforcement decisions)
why_relevant: Statutorily published final/enforceable ČNB decisions (anonymised as to third parties), updated daily via a dedicated application. Enforcement is where abstract supervisory expectation becomes concrete: the decisions reveal which control failures ČNB actually sanctions, which is the strongest evidence base for supervisory priorities in the cell.

source_name: ČNB – Zprávy o výkonu dohledu nad finančním trhem (annual supervision reports)
why_relevant: Statutory annual report submitted to the Chamber of Deputies, Senate and Government by 30 June, covering licensing activity, regulation, supervision and per-sector analysis. A fixed-calendar, retrospective anchor that also states the coming year's regulatory agenda; EN version customarily published too.

source_name: ČNB – SDAT: změny v platných metodikách (supervisory reporting methodology changes)
why_relevant: SDAT is ČNB's supervisory data-collection system; this page tracks changes to the reporting methodologies and their effective dates. Reporting-methodology change is the most operationally binding, most deadline-dense form of CZ regulation for banks and PSPs, and it drives concrete IT and vendor work.

source_name: ČNB – Předpisy k měnové a finanční statistice / předpisy ČNB – statistika
why_relevant: The statistical-reporting vyhlášky and opatření obliging banks to submit výkazy to ČNB — a distinct binding rule family that sits outside the supervision chapter and is easily missed by a supervision-only crawl.

source_name: ČNB – Vybrané předpisy vztahující se k platebnímu styku
why_relevant: Payments-operations view of the applicable rule set (as distinct from the supervision-chapter view), covering the payment-systems side of ČNB's own operations and the payment-services legal framework. Useful cross-check that no payments instrument is missed by the supervision-only crawl.

source_name: ČNB – Opatření obecné povahy ke stanovení sazby proticyklické kapitálové rezervy (CCyB)
why_relevant: The clearest live example of ČNB's 'opatření obecné povahy' instrument type — sequentially numbered (I/2021, III/2021, …), each with a stated rate and an application date typically 12 months ahead. Directly binding on CZ banks' capital planning and a textbook forward-dated deadline source.

source_name: ČNB – Rozhodnutí bankovní rady ČNB (Bank Board decisions, financial stability)
why_relevant: Bank Board decisions on macroprudential instruments and buffers — the decision layer immediately upstream of the opatření obecné povahy, so it gives a short lead on binding capital/lending requirements.

source_name: CNB (EN) – Laws, regulations and guidelines in the financial market area
why_relevant: English mirror of the legislativní základna, with the same sectoral child structure. Not a complete translation of the Czech corpus, but indispensable for aligning Czech instrument names to English terminology and for any analysis handed to non-Czech readers. Useful as a coverage-delta detector: what exists in cs but not en marks the untranslated core.

source_name: ČNB – Informační povinnosti dohlížených subjektů (disclosure duties, incl. link registers)
why_relevant: Sets out what supervised entities must themselves publish, and maintains registers of links to the institutions' own mandatory-disclosure pages. Doubles as a pointer that snowballs into a full actor list of CZ banks/credit unions with their disclosure endpoints — a bridge from the ČNB cell into entity-level sources.

source_name: ČNB – Povolovací a schvalovací řízení, registrace (licensing procedures, payments)
why_relevant: Documents the market-entry requirements and application procedures for payment institutions, EMIs and small-scale providers — the practical translation of the rules into filing obligations. Note the legacy underscore URL pattern, evidence of an older site generation still being served; useful for locating archived material.

source_name: ČNB – Kalendář (event calendar: pre-announced publications and decisions)
why_relevant: Pre-announces the dates of ČNB publications and decisions (confirmed to include publication of the CCyB opatření obecné povahy). Converts the cell from reactive scraping into a scheduled watch — the natural backbone of a regulatory-deadline calendar.

source_name: ČNB – Archiv Komise pro cenné papíry (predecessor regulator archive)
why_relevant: Pre-2006 material from the Securities Commission, absorbed into ČNB on unification of supervision. Matters for long-horizon institutional memory and for tracing the provenance of methodologies still cited today; also flags that ČNB does preserve predecessor-body corpora rather than deleting them.

source_name: ČNB – Harmonogramy a další informace (schedule of published information, XLS)
why_relevant: Publishes a downloadable Harmonogram zveřejňovaných informací (XLS, ~1 MB) plus banking-board meeting dates — a machine-readable annual timetable of what ČNB releases and when. Ideal single-file ingest for a supervisory/publication calendar.
